divergences.title: Verity packet lacks the family 1.2.0 namespace/source lock
divergences.disposition: Add a future non-semantic Verity family provenance projection through Verity change control; do not rewrite its accepted packet here.

divergences.title: Capability manifest and discovery shapes are not one shared contract
divergences.disposition: Retain packet-specific forms and compare actual consumer needs after implementation.

divergences.title: Permission vocabularies differ across the legacy and current packets
divergences.disposition: Define an explicit legacy mapping only when a consumer needs it; never infer credentials or action permissions.

divergences.title: Verity uses heuristic_static while current family packets use heuristic
divergences.disposition: Require a versioned evidence-class migration/compatibility decision before cross-packet normalization.

divergences.title: Completion payload shapes differ despite matching top-level states
divergences.disposition: Keep common top-level meaning and capability-specific details.

divergences.title: Verity result-reference contract is prose, while Titra and Ortha have schemas
divergences.disposition: Exercise a Verity projection with a real consumer before any shared result-reference stabilization.

divergences.title: Schema IDs use absolute Verity IDs versus local relative Titra/Ortha IDs
divergences.disposition: Titra and Ortha reuse relative schema IDs for different bytes; establish collision-free retrieval identities before shared interchange.

divergences.title: Verity safe wrapper default runtime lacks PyYAML
divergences.disposition: Preserve the exact safe preflight and documented preconfigured runtime; resolve portable bootstrap separately without installation here.

divergences.title: Security profiles differ among read-heavy audit, execution verification, and read-heavy aggregation
divergences.disposition: Preserve operation-specific profiles; do not normalize permissions.

divergences.title: Domain payloads differ by design
divergences.disposition: Protect audit, verification, and conformance semantics from shared-domain abstraction.

divergences.title: Verity has no governed combined packet writer contract in repository validators
divergences.disposition: Require a Verity-owned writer command and exact declared write set before writer conformance is claimed.

divergences.title: Verity task index has no machine readiness status
divergences.disposition: Do not equate FOUNDATION-001 dependency-root position with ready status.

divergences.title: Native result references do not satisfy imported-result source requirements without enrichment
divergences.disposition: Define and test explicit reference-to-import enrichment/transformation contracts, including Verity's missing projection.

prohibited_conclusion: This register does not authorize a shared SDK/runtime or imply implementation compatibility.
